name: Slow Down Ideas
description: Ten ideas for easing the pace of a short break.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A deck of ideas for slowing down during a short break, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Try one idea, or none.
howToPlay: Read the idea on the card.
Press Show more for a gentle suggestion.
Press Next when you want another.
tips: These are general ideas for a break, not advice. Stop if anything does not feel good.
